chunks: And the Scholar, peace be upon him, said:
I guarantee for whoever is moderate that he will not become poor.

key_terms.يَفْتَقِرَ: to become poor or fall into poverty

ai.seo_question: How does moderation in spending protect a person from poverty?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that moderation and balanced spending are a safeguard against poverty. It highlights economic restraint as a practical ethical principle for maintaining financial stability.
